items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I’m not locking in with Freddie and John, whichever John it might be.

ctx.x: Yeah. But you know I’ve said this all my life. Four and a half years — blizzards, rain storms, getting lost, yeah we got lost all the time, the bus drivers didn’t know where to go and we couldn’t tell them, that’s what we hired him, Basie hired him for, to get us there. And getting to places that we really didn’t want to be, sometimes no food, sometimes no overcoat, just a whole bunch of stuff I never ever, ever heard the band sound bad. Never. Four and a half years of one-nighters. They always sounded good. Many…
Just a word about this phenomenon of these jazz festivals, these jazz parties, it’s like a great thing for musicians.
